title: Prevent launch autonomy self-block
summary: Prevent the pipeline-side autonomy health gate from counting the current PowerShell launch process ActiveJobs record as external active work.
reason: A pipeline start writes an ActiveJobs row before MediaPipeline.ps1 runs the autonomy health CLI gate. The gate could then see that same just-created row as active work, abort with exit 76, and leave a failed ActiveJobs record that blocks later launch/close readiness evidence.
behavior_before: The backend-created ActiveJobs row for the current pipeline process could be treated as active external work by the pipeline's own autonomy health gate, causing a self-blocking exit 76 before queue work started.
behavior_after: MediaPipeline.ps1 includes the current PowerShell PID in the autonomy health gate payload. The CLI passes that PID as an ignore list to the read-only autonomy health evaluator, which excludes only exact current-PID ActiveJobs rows from the direct workers scan and runtime ActiveJobs counters. Other active, failed, stale, unreadable, or ambiguous records still block.
rollback_plan: Revert the PID ignore plumbing in MediaPipeline.ps1, autonomy_health_gate.py, autonomy_health.py, runtime_health.py, and the added autonomy health tests; regenerate summaries for those files.
notes:
Prevent pipeline-side autonomy health from treating the current launch process ActiveJobs row as an external blocker.
Python impact: autonomy_health_payload and runtime_reliability_counters accept an optional ActiveJobs PID ignore list used by the CLI gate only; normal backend Diagnostics and Launch preflight calls keep strict read-first behavior.
